_what_this_is: The approved production release policy for Milk Pop. This file is the TRUST ANCHOR: verification is judged against it, never against anything inside a release. It contains only PUBLIC information; the private signing key lives solely in GitHub Secrets (MP_SIGNING_KEY).
_before_first_production_deploy: 1. Keep the PRIVATE Ed25519 key only in the protected GitHub production secret MP_SIGNING_KEY; never commit it.
2. This file pins the matching PUBLIC key, the approved production Supabase project ref and milkpop.uk.
3. minimum_release_number is the offline emergency floor. Routine anti-rollback is enforced by the signed live release marker; do not edit this file after every normal deploy.
4. Change the trust anchor only deliberately (for example key rotation, project migration, domain migration or an emergency release-floor reset), then reseal and re-verify the source.
